title: OmniVoice Studio: Local Voice Cloning and Dubbing
summary: A privacy-focused desktop application for zero-shot voice cloning, cinematic dubbing, and real-time dictation across 600+ languages. It executes 100% locally with support for NVIDIA, Apple Silicon, and AMD accelerators.
research_notes: Integrates Demucs for audio separation and has a roadmap for Wav2Lip v2 integration to enhance video dubbing realism.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a raw model wrapper into a full Tauri-based desktop suite featuring OS-level dictation widgets and MCP server integration. It now utilizes the 'uv' package manager for zero-dependency local bootstrapping.
